children: Cantor Equity Partners IV will hold its annual shareholder meeting on December 29, 2026, with a resolution to reappoint two Class I directors.
The annual meeting is scheduled for 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time in New York.
Shareholders must submit proposals by December 6, 2026, and proposals must meet applicable legal, SEC and charter requirements.
The meeting satisfies Nasdaq’s annual meeting requirement for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025.
Class B shareholders will consider reappointing Douglas R. Barnard and Dr. Mukesh Prasad as Class I directors.
